subject: Reference-modification
notes: The unique data item is a SUBSET with its own positions, not a view of the base item's width: pb297 T01/T02/T03 compare the same item at 1, 2 and 4 positions and get three different sizings of the same figurative (5b/5c), T05 evaluates leftmost-position and length from DATA ITEMS at runtime, and T06 takes 5c's omitted 'to the end' form. ec_bound_ref_mod pins 5b/5c's range obligation and the EC-BOUND-REF-MOD raise; ref_mod_zero_length pins 5c's REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH exemption. 5a's BIT-position arm is pinned separately by conformance:cases/13.16-Data-description/pb79_group_usage_bit.
